description: List available Adobe Media Encoder export presets, with the .epr path of each so it can be passed to export_sequence or encode_project_item. Presets are discovered by scanning the .epr files Adobe ships on disk (Premiere's ExtendScript API exposes no preset enumeration).

format.description: Filter by container/format (e.g. 'H.264', 'mp4', 'QuickTime', 'WAV') or preset name (e.g. 'ProRes', 'Proxy'). Presets whose format matches come first. Omit to list all.

name: get_encoder_presets

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Encoder Presets
